pkgmetadata.longdescription: hashicorp/waypoint was archived by its upstream maintainer on 2024-01-08. This package tracks v0.11.4 (2023-08-09), the final release, which was also the last one published under MPL-2.0 before HashiCorp's 2023-08-10 switch to BUSL-1.1 for all subsequent releases of its products. No further updates or security fixes will be published upstream.
